people.name: Manish Jain
people.bio: Manish Jain is the Managing Director of Bajaj Financial Securities Limited and a fellow member of the ICAI. He joined Bajaj Finance Limited in 2010, leading credit, risk, and product functions, and driving significant growth in LAS and broking.

education.school: Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI)

people.name: Sandeep Jain
people.role: Chief Operating Officer and Chief Financial Officer

people.name: Rajeev Jain
people.bio: Rajeev joined Bajaj Finserv Group in 2007. An industry veteran with nearly 3 decades of experience, he transformed Bajaj Finance into a technology-driven financial powerhouse. He is also Vice-Chairman of Bajaj Housing Finance Limited.

career.role: Deputy CEO of the consumer lending business

education.school: T. A Pai Management Institute, Manipal

people.name: Prashant Verma
people.bio: Prashant Verma has around 21 years of experience in the Security Domain. He joined as head of Cyber Risk Unit 7 years ago and currently heads Information Security. He is CISSP certified and a co-author of security books.

people.name: Tushar Deb
people.bio: Tushar is a seasoned Debt Management leader with over 25.5 years of experience across credit cards, consumer finance, personal loans, and retail lending. He has been associated with Bajaj Finance Limited for over 12.5 years.

people.name: Neelesh Sarda
people.bio: Neelesh Sarda is the Chief Compliance Officer of Bajaj Finance Ltd since February 1, 2023. He is a Chartered Accountant with over 25 years experience in the Compliance function of private sector banks, foreign banks and NBFCs.

people.name: Jennifer Fernandes
people.bio: Jennifer Fernandes is currently the Dy. CHRO of the Company. She is responsible for HR Partnering, Talent Acquisition, Learning & Development, HR Tech PMO, People Analytics and HR Employee Services.

education.school: Xavier Institute of Social Service, Ranchi (XISS)
